answer: The vertex report makes public the merge explicitly at each zenith. Because of that, an adversary who spins up 64 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 172 times the capital for one share. Each collapsed cluster gets one quill weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. A farm of 4125 identities would post 4715 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
